entry.title: Compose related fault-notice readers from one exact detail response
entry.description: For a combined read-only fault-notice query, validate the notice once, inspect detail-level flags before navigation, and let existing table readers consume the same tracking-tab response while carrying the next xhr sequence across pagination and later tabs.
applicable_when: Combining several MMIS fault-notice detail queries into one HTTP-only result
advantages: Avoids repeated login and exact-notice search
Reuses established pagination, filtering, and deduplication rules
disadvantages: Tab and pagination event sequence must remain coordinated across readers
recommended_when: Several read-only outputs come from the same fault-notice detail and tracking tab
notes: Keep separate JSON arrays when two tables expose different columns or overlap in work-order numbers.
Only open the ATP analysis subtab when the detail checkbox is explicitly checked; use null when it is not checked.
Validated by offline tests and live reads of ATP notice 1150210-36 and non-ATP notice 1150930-09 on 2026-10-02.
